name: Kuranushi Mizuki
source:
[spoiler]Name: Mizuki Kuranushi
Sex: Female
Age: 18 (Past) | 24 (Present)
Birthday: August 10
Profession: ABIS Undercover Special Agent
Likes: Mizuki Date
Dislikes: Anyone Who Messes With Mizuki Date
Hobbies: Watching Over Mizuki Date
Skills: Guessing Which Panties Mizuki Date Is Wearing That Day

[url=/c101029]Mizuki Date[/url] was born from her DNA, almost like a little sister. She lived at Aioen until she was 9 years old. Mizuki Kuranushi secretly watched over Mizuki Date from afar, watching her grow up.

[Edited from the in-game character descriptions]

Bibi was originally taken in by the Chieda Family, becoming [url=/c107321]Kizuna[/url]'s "Big Sis". She was adopted at 15 by [url=/c85775]Shizue "Boss" Kuranushi[/url], then trained and admitted into ABIS at 18. She previously worked as a thief for the Kumakura Family, going by the codename "Quartz" and assisted by [url=/c108945]Lien[/url].
Bibi is the protagonist during "Mizuki Chapter 2" and "Mizuki Chapter 4", both set in the Past, where she is 18 years old and looks the same as 18-year-old Mizuki Date in the Present. She is accompanied by [url=/c85761]Aiba[/url] in the Past and by [url=/c112134]Marco[/url] in the Present.[/spoiler]
